_comment: Surface-speed colour scale for the Introduction's 'Greenland flows' step. ONE source of truth: cinematic/scene_01_intro/build_flow_trails.py colours the drape from these stops, website/src/config/velocityScale.ts colours the colorbar (and places its ticks) with the same log mapping. Stops are [fraction of the log10 range vmin..vmax, hex]; sampled from NASA SVS 3848's ice_velocity_scale.png (Rignot et al., log 1-3000 m/yr). Editing this file means re-running the builder and uploading the drape under a NEW name.
